findings.issue: The new isPrivateHelperSpecifier replaces the old catch-all '<pkg>/…/src/' shape with an explicit list. It covers '@stynx-nyx/<helper>/src' and '@stynx-nyx/<helper>/testing/src'. For relative paths it covers '<helper>/(src|testing)' and 'testing/index'. Something like '../packages-web/angular-auth/<other>/src/x' would have matched the old regex and does not match the new one. No such directory exists: the only src directories in these packages are packages-web/angular-auth/src, packages-web/angular-i18n/src and packages/testing/src, all at the package root. This is not a practical weakening. Every vector requested in cycle 2 is now rejected and asserted by self-test: scoped '/src/' paths, relative 'testing|angular-auth|angular-i18n/(src|testing)' paths and 'testing/index[.ts]'. Public subpaths are asserted as allowed, and a size==10 guard now makes the file list non-vacuous.
findings.required_change: None. If new directories are added under the helper packages later, extend the rejection vectors to cover them.

summary:
I reviewed ff576adc against the cycle-2 PASS HEAD 189b64bb. The delta is 4 commits: Architect d2d5dd7c, Inspector ecc0e342, Architect 9dcdecc5 and Architect ff576adc. Each is authored under the matching DEVAI role identity. Only test/sensor, Vitest config, trace and round documents change. There is no product-source or public-API change.

(1) Import detector. The inline regex is now the testable isPrivateHelperSpecifier. It has 9 rejection vectors, covering every sample from cycle 2 (scoped src, relative src, relative testing/index), and 5 allowed vectors for the published subpaths, a non-helper package and vitest. The adoption test still asserts each required published import in all 10 files, now behind an explicit size==10 guard. Every specifier is checked against the stricter detector. Nothing was weakened, and the rest of the diff is Prettier reflow.

(2) Fake resolution. packages/data/vitest.config.ts and vitest.stryker.config.ts now alias '@stynx-nyx/testing' to testing/src/fake-transaction.ts instead of the barrel. The only import in data is `createFakeTransaction` in test/unit/transaction.spec.ts, and there are no subpath imports that the prefix alias could mangle. fake-transaction.ts imports Transaction from '@stynx-nyx/data', which still resolves to data src/index.ts. So class identity with the spec's '../../src/transaction' holds, and the transitive runtime load of sessions/dist is gone. The integration config does not use the alias and is unaffected, and no manifest dependency was added.

(3) Trace. law/trace.json adds one Architect rebind note and updates the sensor file's projection from 2 to 5 assertions with a new digest.

I ran these myself: `node --test` on the sensor passed 2/2, `pnpm check:trace` returned [trace][ok] 442 executable tests bound; 442 tracked, and the data unit Vitest run passed 11 files and 90/90 tests. I did not re-run lint:tests or the focused data typecheck; the maestro reports them passing. The cycle-1 and cycle-2 MUST proofs are untouched by this delta, and the cycle-2 PASS still applies.

Both cycle-2 minors are resolved. HEAD ff576adcf847141c70455c127f9a27fbcda8657a is safe for cumulative import under OD-S15-02. As the plan says, this does not replace the final review of the integrated tree.
